body_text:
Jasmin, this is what you've missed on LinkedIn

-----------------------------------------


LinkedIn News shared a post: Suddenly, everyone seems to be talking about “quiet quitting” — so, what is it? In a nutshell, "quiet quitting" is when a worker meets their minimum job requirements....and that's it. This can can mean radio silence after 5PM, avoiding non-mandatory meetings and events or turning down projects: https://lnkd.in/eKWyuF47 Is quiet quitting really a new trend, born out of burnout, or is it just a new name for the very old experience of gradually giving up on a job? What causes it? And what's the right response? Take our poll and leave your thoughts in the comments. ✍🏻: Max Lockie

-----------------------------------------


California Institute of the Arts shared a post: The School of Film/Video at #CalArts has been ranked fifth in The Hollywood Reporter’s 2022 ranking of the 25 Best American #Film Schools, citing its approaches to both ‘traditional and experimental mediamaking’ and the ‘unique equipment’ available to students. Read more at 24700. https://lnkd.in/gG8GkRHi

-----------------------------------------


California Institute of the Arts shared a post: ‘Baldwin was not a single story; there were many Baldwins.’ #CalArts School of Critical Studies faculty and performance artist Gabrielle Civil was quoted in the Miami Herald’s recent article about the 2022 International Conference on James Baldwin held in Nice, France. Read more at the Miami Herald. https://lnkd.in/g6sTuYXv #CriticalStudies

California Institute of the Arts shared a post: CalArts student Erika Salazar Gutierrez is among the 11 students and young professionals announced as a 2022 Academy of Interactive Arts & Sciences Foundation Scholar. Gutierrez was awarded a WomenIn Scholarship (one of the three scholarships awarded by AIAS), which seeks to "attract, retain and advance women in the interactive entertainment industry by supporting their education and professional development." https://lnkd.in/ghBBiEw5

-----------------------------------------


LinkedIn News shared a post: Your job skills are like seeing The Matrix 🕶 LinkedIn editor-in-chief Daniel Roth discusses how to translate everyday skills into buzzwords for your resume on the TODAY Show. Here's more on why skills-based hiring is on the rise: https://lnkd.in/gQk24dz8

-----------------------------------------


LinkedIn News shared a post: There are tens of thousands of U.S. government allies who remain in Iraq and Afghanistan– their lives endangered because of their association and support of Americans during the war. But evacuating and resettling them hasn’t been easy. Nina Melendez Ibarra Melendez sits down with Jeff Phaneuf and Ali Seena (He/Him/His) of No One Left Behind to discuss the efforts behind getting former interpreters and government workers to safety. Click the “Attend” button to get a notification when the show begins. Have questions for our guests? Let us know in the comments below and get them answered when we go LIVE. #LinkedInNewsLive

-----------------------------------------


LinkedIn News shared a post: Employees are shifting their priorities in the workplace. New studies suggest that there is less focus on climbing corporate ladders. Find out more below. #TrendingNow Read more: https://lnkd.in/ertNjsNr

LinkedIn News shared a post: You may have heard the acronym OKR thrown around at work. The initials stand for objectives and key results, which is a way to set goals with clear outcomes. Jessie Withers, M.A.'s LinkedIn Learning lesson on OKRs is the most popular course of the year! She will join LinkedIn News editor Andrew Seaman to discuss the ins and outs of goal setting on Friday, August 12, for #GetHired Live. They’ll also answer your questions! subject: LinkedIn News shared a post: Suddenly,...
body_text:
Jasmin, this is what you've missed on LinkedIn

-----------------------------------------


LinkedIn News shared a post: Suddenly, everyone seems to be talking about “quiet quitting” — so, what is it? In a nutshell, "quiet quitting" is when a worker meets their minimum job requirements....and that's it. This can can mean radio silence after 5PM, avoiding non-mandatory meetings and events or turning down projects: https://lnkd.in/eKWyuF47 Is quiet quitting really a new trend, born out of burnout, or is it just a new name for the very old experience of gradually giving up on a job? What causes it? And what's the right response? Take our poll and leave your thoughts in the comments. ✍🏻: Max Lockie

-----------------------------------------


California Institute of the Arts shared a post: The School of Film/Video at #CalArts has been ranked fifth in The Hollywood Reporter’s 2022 ranking of the 25 Best American #Film Schools, citing its approaches to both ‘traditional and experimental mediamaking’ and the ‘unique equipment’ available to students. Read more at 24700. https://lnkd.in/gG8GkRHi

-----------------------------------------


California Institute of the Arts shared a post: ‘Baldwin was not a single story; there were many Baldwins.’ #CalArts School of Critical Studies faculty and performance artist Gabrielle Civil was quoted in the Miami Herald’s recent article about the 2022 International Conference on James Baldwin held in Nice, France. Read more at the Miami Herald. https://lnkd.in/g6sTuYXv #CriticalStudies

-----------------------------------------


California Institute of the Arts shared a post: CalArts student Erika Salazar Gutierrez is among the 11 students and young professionals announced as a 2022 Academy of Interactive Arts & Sciences Foundation Scholar. Gutierrez was awarded a WomenIn Scholarship (one of the three scholarships awarded by AIAS), which seeks to "attract, retain and advance women in the interactive entertainment industry by supporting their education and professional development." https://lnkd.in/ghBBiEw5

-----------------------------------------


LinkedIn News shared a post: Your job skills are like seeing The Matrix 🕶 LinkedIn editor-in-chief Daniel Roth discusses how to translate everyday skills into buzzwords for your resume on the TODAY Show. Here's more on why skills-based hiring is on the rise: https://lnkd.in/gQk24dz8

-----------------------------------------


LinkedIn News shared a post: There are tens of thousands of U.S. government allies who remain in Iraq and Afghanistan– their lives endangered because of their association and support of Americans during the war. But evacuating and resettling them hasn’t been easy. Nina Melendez Ibarra Melendez sits down with Jeff Phaneuf and Ali Seena (He/Him/His) of No One Left Behind to discuss the efforts behind getting former interpreters and government workers to safety. Click the “Attend” button to get a notification when the show begins. Have questions for our guests? Let us know in the comments below and get them answered when we go LIVE. #LinkedInNewsLive

-----------------------------------------


LinkedIn News shared a post: Mindy Kaling shares the best career advice she's ever gotten, the traits that make a good leader, and how to embrace criticism. #RapidFire You can catch up on all our Rapid Fire episodes here: https://lnkd.in/RapidFire

-----------------------------------------


LinkedIn News shared a post: Employees are shifting their priorities in the workplace. New studies suggest that there is less focus on climbing corporate ladders. Find out more below. #TrendingNow Read more: https://lnkd.in/ertNjsNr

-----------------------------------------


LinkedIn News shared a post: You may have heard the acronym OKR thrown around at work. The initials stand for objectives and key results, which is a way to set goals with clear outcomes. Jessie Withers, M.A.'s LinkedIn Learning lesson on OKRs is the most popular course of the year! She will join LinkedIn News editor Andrew Seaman to discuss the ins and outs of goal setting on Friday, August 12, for #GetHired Live. They’ll also answer your questions!
